news.h: NFL trade deadline grades: Deals for Jacoby Brissett, Jeffery Simmons, more
news.d: Wise move for the Ravens to add Jacoby Brissett? Did the Bears give up too much to go all-in with Jeffery Simmons? Let's evaluate eight trades before the deadline.

news.h: Jeffery Simmons stymies QB Sam Darnold, Seahawks in Bears debut
news.d: New Bears DT Jeffery Simmons had a sack, six tackles and deflected a pass as Chicago won its third straight Monday, and he also earned a game ball.

news.h: Jeffery Simmons, Bears' defense handle Seahawks
news.d: Caleb Williams and Jeffery Simmons had the Bears controlling both sides of the ball on MNF.

news.h: Caleb Williams and Jeffery Simmons lead the Bears past the Seahawks 34-17
news.d: — Jeffery Simmons ran out of the tunnel for the first time since joining the Chicago Bears with a new uniform, orange sleeves and a wide smile as he welcomed the move that put right into contention...

news.h: Sources: Bears, Titans used Myles Garrett deal as framework for Simmons trade
news.d: The Bears and Titans came up with a Jeffery Simmons proposal that was based off this year's Myles Garrett trade.
